catalog_quirks.body: Api.Airforce Free grants 1,000 requests per day at 1 request per minute per account with per-model token caps and no card. The 21 listed routes returned matching model IDs on September 15. kimi-k2.7-code requires a paid plan; gpt-oss-120b, Mistral Large and Mistral Medium returned 503 and are excluded. Most routes are proxied Mistral free-plan models; treat them as sharing that upstream capacity.
